==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, my name is CD. I am a detective superhero. I do possess powers, but they are dependent on a group of lab technicians.

When the technicians activate me, I become animalistic and start walking on all-fours. In my beastial form, I can crawl up and down walls with ease. While activated, I have to absorb radiation to maintain my powers.

I am investigating a large tree that seems to be sapping the planet of its energy. I feel like the tree is connected to an event in this world's past. I wake up before I can figure out the connection.
